project_type: Python monorepo — Kiro Crew gateway/dashboard backend (aiohttp) plus a Vite/React website; work here is entirely in the Python backend under src/kiro_crew/
build_system: Make + setuptools. `make backend` provisions .venv and pip-installs `-e .[dev]` plus the PEP 735 dev group. `make build` builds frontend+backend; `make test` runs `.venv/bin/pytest -q`.
test_framework: pytest. Root conftest.py is the host-mutation floor (pins KIROCREW_HOME, XDG, credentials). test/conftest.py holds suite isolation and provides fixtures used by the target tests: `fake_home`, `requires_symlinks`, plus helpers `_agents_dir(fake_home)` in test/test_agent_discovery.py. testpaths also include transfer/ and src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins.
build_command: make build  (requires network for pip install — NOT available in this sandbox; see environment_constraints)
test_command: make test  (equivalently .venv/bin/pytest -q). Targeted: .venv/bin/pytest -q test/test_agent_discovery.py test/test_cli_doctor.py <new test module>
verification_instructions: Full pytest run requires the .venv from `make backend`, which pip-installs aiohttp and other deps from PyPI. That network is BLOCKED here (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY). Host-based verification available in this sandbox: (1) byte-compile every changed file with a pyenv 3.12 interpreter: `~/.pyenv/versions/3.12.13/bin/python -m py_compile <files>`; (2) lint changed files with `~/.pyenv/versions/3.12.13/bin/ruff check <files>` (ruff 0.16.1 is on the 3.12 interpreter). black is NOT importable on the pyenv interpreters (only the ruff console script and the pyenv shim exist), so use `ruff format --check` for formatting instead of black. The pytest suite itself must be run in CI / a networked build env; record it as deferred.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant to this change. (.github/coverage-baselines/ and black-baseline.txt exist but are CI gate inputs, not regenerated by this task.)
setup_instructions: In a networked environment: `make backend` (creates .venv, installs deps). In THIS sandbox: use pyenv interpreters directly for syntax/lint only — `~/.pyenv/versions/3.12.13/bin/python` and its `ruff`. Do NOT attempt pip install (PyPI proxy returns 403).
environment_constraints: NETWORK = INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. PyPI is unreachable (pip install fails with proxy 403). No .venv exists and none can be built (aiohttp/pytest deps uninstallable). No vendored wheels, no usable pip cache. Therefore the full pytest suite CANNOT be executed here. Verification in-sandbox is limited to py_compile + ruff on changed files. Runtime test execution is deferred to CI. Do NOT mark a feature blocked solely because pytest cannot run — that is an environment limitation, not a defect; still WRITE the tests.
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md + TENETS.md: dense, reason-giving comments explaining WHY (the surrounding code is heavily commented in this style — match it). Preserve each caller's existing failure semantics. black line-length=100, isort profile=black, ruff. Do not commit to main; work on a branch.

Reference migrations already in tree: session.py SessionManager._resolve_agent_model (~2724, the #5423 fix — glob + `_read_agent_spec` + `if ad is None: continue`), cli_doctor.py (~171/446), agent.py `_read_spec_capped` wrapper (~2704) that just calls `_read_agent_spec`, agent_discovery.list_agents (~770) which uses it in its scan.
